title: senna intermedia
intro: Senna intermedia, commonly known as the Himalayan senna, is a plant species belonging to the legume family and is native to the Himalayan region. The health benefits of Senna intermedia include its use in treating digestive issues, such as constipation and bloating, due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Senna intermedia include anthraquinone glycosides, such as senoside B and aloe-emodin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
